notes.title: Bug Fix for Korean, Trad. Chinese, and Spanish Languages Implementation Update
notes.content:
Dear Tsugunohi fans,

We have discovered an issue in the June 15th language update where the 3 newly added languages were not implemented properly and could not be switched to in-game. 
We are terribly sorry for any inconveniences this may have caused, especially to the users who were trying to access the 3 languages. 
Today, July 6th, we have fixed this issue. First, select the desired language in the Steam Properties menu, then update the game!

notes.title: Now Available on Steam! Featuring Ai’s Silent Cries with Kizuna Ai!
notes.content:
[b]The Legendary Horror Series with Over 54 Million Streaming Views
Featuring Ai’s Silent Cries, a Steam Original Scenario with Kizuna Ai[/b]

Tsugunohi was developed by ImCyan and originally released on Freem! and other free game websites in 2012. Since then, Tsugunohi Let's Plays have amassed over 54 million views worldwide, establishing it as one of the legendary horror titles. Coming to Steam on August 13th, this new version will include nine episodes and be supported in English, Japanese, and Simplified Chinese.

Furthermore, we have collaborated with Kizuna Ai, a popular Japanese Vtuber, for Ai’s Silent Cries, an original Steam scenario.

[b]Ai’s Silent Cries (Steam Original)[/b]
Kizuna Ai is on her way home after a live broadcast. The road home today feels different, but somehow familiar...

notes.title: Tsugunohi is set to release on Steam in early 2021.
notes.content:
Dear fans.

Tsugunohi , a popular game from Game magazine, is set to release on Steam in early 2021.
Tsugunohi is a horror game that has been gaining attention on social media with its unique system where everyday life is gradually eroded by fear as you walk sideways. Live gameplay related videos have been viewed more than 25 million times.

Now, a completely new Steam original episode recording is in the works!　Today, the teaser visual for the complete new game has been released.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37835843/fc096c4e4137d5d4beb8e1ab83fad99b24707a03.png[/img]

The setting of the new game is the "railroad crossing" where the train that appeared in the previous title "Tsugunohi  -The parallel train in the dark-", which is included in the game, runs.
The main character, a young girl, is dragged into the railroad crossing by the spirit of a living embodiment.
You'll have to see with your own eyes what kind of terror she's going through!


Also, the first, second and third episodes of Tsugunohi will be remastered for the Steam version release.

We hope you enjoy all these Game Magazine titles!
